title: Bladder / Urothelial Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for urothelial bladder cancer. Captures clinical setting (muscle-invasive peri-operative vs metastatic/locally advanced) and, for metastatic disease, line of therapy, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Bladder Cancer; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Bladder Cancer. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Setting
nodes.title: Setting
nodes.description: Muscle-invasive urothelial bladder cancer is treated with peri-operative (neoadjuvant or adjuvant) platinum-based chemotherapy around definitive local therapy; metastatic or locally advanced disease is treated with systemic therapy alone, sequenced by line.

nodes.name: Metastatic line of therapy
nodes.title: Metastatic line of therapy
nodes.description: Metastatic/locally advanced urothelial cancer is sequenced by line: first-line platinum-based chemotherapy, switch-maintenance therapy after response to first-line platinum, or later-line therapy after progression.
nodes.path: Bladder Cancer / Metastatic / Line of therapy

nodes.name: Muscle-invasive: neoadjuvant / adjuvant platinum chemotherapy
nodes.title: Muscle-invasive: neoadjuvant / adjuvant platinum chemotherapy
nodes.description: Muscle-invasive urothelial bladder cancer - peri-operative platinum-based combination chemotherapy given neoadjuvantly or adjuvantly around definitive local therapy. Physician selects the specific regimen.

nodes.name: Metastatic first-line: platinum chemotherapy
nodes.title: Metastatic first-line: platinum chemotherapy
nodes.description: Metastatic/locally advanced urothelial cancer, first-line - platinum-based combination chemotherapy. Physician selects the specific regimen.

nodes.name: Metastatic switch-maintenance: avelumab
nodes.title: Metastatic switch-maintenance: avelumab
nodes.description: Metastatic/locally advanced urothelial cancer with response or stable disease after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy - switch-maintenance immunotherapy.

nodes.name: Metastatic later-line: enfortumab vedotin
nodes.title: Metastatic later-line: enfortumab vedotin
nodes.description: Metastatic/locally advanced urothelial cancer after progression on prior platinum-based chemotherapy (and/or immunotherapy) - later-line antibody-drug conjugate.
